components.name: Kit navigation
components.description: Identity-kit section links, not an app navigation pattern. Targets retain a 44px minimum height. The surrounding masthead, not rendered in this snippet, preserves the 104px wordmark with flex-shrink: 0 on its link; its gap changes from 2rem to .75rem (12px at the default 16px root size) at widths of 700px or less.
components.html: MarksSystemUse it
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 2.5rem); color: var(--ink, #171719); font-family: "Hanken Grotesk", sans-serif; } .ds-nav a { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; font-size: .95rem; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.5; color: inherit; text-decoration: none; text-underline-offset: .25em; text-decoration-thickness: 1px; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: #f2cf4566; } .ds-nav a:hover { text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-thickness: 2px; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid currentColor; outline-offset: 5px; }

components.name: Swap sides
components.description: Native checkbox and original 140 x 120 paired-arch paths from index.html. Both paths remain present; Rock red and Scissors blue fills exchange. The 700px query belongs to the kit preview.
components.html: Same shape. Different sides.
components.css: .ds-swap { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto auto; justify-content: center; align-items: center; gap: 0 .7rem; color: var(--ink, #171719); font-family: "Hanken Grotesk", sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-swap svg { display: block; max-width: 100%; height: auto; grid-column: 1 / -1; grid-row: 1; width: min(100%, 340px); margin-bottom: 3rem; overflow: visible; } .ds-swap input { justify-self: end; width: 1.15rem; height: 1.15rem; margin: 0; accent-color: var(--ink, #171719); cursor: pointer; } .ds-swap label { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-swap input, .ds-swap label { -webkit-tap-highlight-color: #f2cf4566; } .ds-swap input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid currentColor; outline-offset: 5px; } .ds-arch-first { fill: var(--faction-rock, #eb6256); } .ds-arch-second { fill: var(--faction-scissors, #69b5f5); } .ds-swap path { transition: fill 320ms cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1); } .ds-swap input:checked ~ svg .ds-arch-first { fill: var(--faction-scissors, #69b5f5); } .ds-swap input:checked ~ svg .ds-arch-second { fill: var(--faction-rock, #eb6256); } .ds-swap-description { color: var(--ink, #171719); font-family: "Hanken Grotesk", sans-serif; font-size: .9rem; line-height: 1.5; text-align: center; margin: 1.25rem 0 0; } @media (max-width: 700px) { .ds-swap svg { width: 180px; margin-bottom: 1.5rem; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-swap path { transition: none; } }

components.name: One-color symbol sheet
components.description: A real asset presentation sheet, not a generic card. Paths copied from assets/symbol.svg; the pale stage is preview-only.
components.css: .ds-symbol-sheet { margin: 0; color: var(--ink, #171719); font-family: "Hanken Grotesk", sans-serif; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-symbol-stage { min-height: 210px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: #f5f5f5; } .ds-symbol-stage svg { display: block; max-width: 100%; height: auto; } .ds-symbol-sheet figcaption { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1rem; font-size: .875rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #d9d9d9); } .ds-symbol-sheet a { color: inherit; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; text-underline-offset: .25em; text-decoration-thickness: 1px; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: #f2cf4566; } .ds-symbol-sheet a:hover { text-decoration-thickness: 2px; } .ds-symbol-sheet a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid currentColor; outline-offset: 5px; } @media (max-width: 700px) { .ds-symbol-stage { min-height: 130px; } .ds-symbol-stage svg { width: 60px; } .ds-symbol-sheet figcaption { display: block; padding-top: .6rem; font-size: .8rem; } .ds-symbol-sheet figcaption > a { display: block; } }

components.css: .ds-palette, .ds-neutral-palette { display: grid; border: 1px solid var(--line, #d9d9d9); color: var(--ink, #171719); font-family: "Hanken Grotesk", sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-palette { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); } .ds-neutral-palette { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; border-top: 0; } .ds-neutral-palette .ds-swatch { min-height: 120px; } .ds-swatch { padding: 1.5rem; min-height: 210px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: start; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-swatch strong { font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-swatch span { margin-top: auto; } .ds-swatch small { font-size: .85rem; margin-top: .25rem; } .ds-rock { background: var(--faction-rock, #eb6256); } .ds-paper { background: var(--faction-paper, #f2cf45); } .ds-scissors { background: var(--faction-scissors, #69b5f5); } .ds-ink { color: var(--white, #ffffff); background: var(--ink, #171719); } .ds-white { background: var(--white, #ffffff); } @media (max-width: 700px) { .ds-palette { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } .ds-swatch { padding: 1rem; min-height: 175px; } }

narrative.overview:
Two equal arches, drawn from reversible team bibs, make a custom lowercase Monk wordmark. Colors exchange while both forms remain. The identity is minimalist but distinct: flat fields, open space, and short, friendly lines. The lead line is "Change sides. Keep playing."

This record covers the built identity kit in `brand/` and its approved app application below. It records the approved palette-only revision of the code-led Side by Side direction; there was no approved image comp. Geometry, typography, and composition structure remain intact. The prior palette's review disposition does not certify this revision; no external review verdict for this revision is recorded here. The repository's `PRODUCT.md` remains product truth; root `DESIGN.md` remains the game/system concept document.

The bounded app extension received a finish disposition of **ship, no material fixes**, based on seven required captures and sampled source. This confirms the inherited identity's app application, not a new visual world or a full marketing-kit re-review; it does not extend the prior palette review.
keyCharacteristics: Custom path lettering and two matching arches.
Three exact faction colors shared with gameplay, supported by ink and white.
Hanken Grotesk supporting copy in sentence case.
Flat, spacious compositions with a short line and a large mark.

rules.name: The Shared Factions Rule
rules.body: Brand and gameplay share the same three colors. Red stays Rock, yellow stays Paper, and blue stays Scissors. Identify factions with names and hand icons as well as color; the app's faction assignments remain unchanged.

rules.name: The Dominant Field Rule
rules.body: Use one dominant faction-color field per marketing composition, with the other two colors as accents.

rules.name: The Readable Pairings Rule
rules.body: Use ink text on white and all three faction colors. White text belongs only on ink, not on red, yellow, or blue.

rules.name: The Lettering Is Artwork Rule
rules.body: Hanken Grotesk supports the identity; it is not the wordmark. Use the supplied SVG paths instead of typing or redrawing "monk".

rules.name: The Flat Fields Rule
rules.body: Keep identity applications flat. Separate fields with color, space, or thin borders; do not add effects to the marks.

rules.name: The Same Shape Rule
rules.body: Exchange the paired arches' colors without moving, removing, or changing either form or the combined silhouette.

rules.name: The Stem Space Rule
rules.body: Leave at least one stem-width of clear space around a mark: 28 source units, scaled with the artwork. Use the wordmark at least 104px wide and the symbol at least 24px wide; below 48px, use the one-color symbol.

dos: **Do** use the supplied wordmark first and the symbol when space is tight.
**Do** preserve one stem-width of clear space and the stated minimum sizes.
**Do** keep both arches present when their colors exchange.
**Do** keep faction meanings fixed and identify factions with names and hand icons as well as color.
**Do** use one dominant faction-color field per marketing composition, with the other two as accents.
**Do** use sentence case and short, friendly invitations, led by "Change sides. Keep playing."
**Do** keep the font license and raster provenance with the distributed assets.
donts: **Don't** stretch, rotate, outline, redraw, or add effects to the marks.
**Don't** typeset the wordmark in Hanken Grotesk or another font.
**Don't** use a paired-color symbol below 48px wide.
**Don't** use white text on faction-color fields; use ink text on all three colors.
**Don't** reassign faction colors or change gameplay through visual updates.
**Don't** present sample graphics as app screenshots or claim trademark clearance.
